receipts.last_text_witness: key is understanding that average doesn't have to be your destiny. With some basic financial discipline and the willingness to make different choices than the majority, you can easily outperform these statistics and build the kind of financial security that most people only dream about. The question isn't whether it's possible to do better than average. It's whether you're ready to stop making excuses and actually do something about it.
